news.headline: In South Korea, women forced into prostitution on US military bases seek justice
news.summary: Tens of thousands of women were forced to work in South Korean state-sanctioned brothels used by American soldiers based in the country after the Korean War. They were raped, physically abused and forcibly confined. Now, after decades of silence, some of these women are speaking out.
